headword: {全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}
gloss: with all one's heart and soul; wholeheartedly

definitions.gloss: with all one's heart and soul; one's whole being
definitions.explanation: Putting all of one's physical and spiritual energy into something.

examples.japanese: {全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}を{込|こ}めて{演奏|えんそう}した。
examples.english: I played with all my heart and soul.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}に{全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}で{取|と}り{組|く}みます。
examples.english: I will devote myself wholeheartedly to this work.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}たちは{全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}をかけて{戦|たたか}った。
examples.english: The athletes fought with everything they had.

notes:
STRUCTURE (YOJIJUKUGO):
{全|ぜん} (whole) + {身|しん} (body) + {全|ぜん} (whole) + {霊|れい} (spirit)
Literal: "whole body, whole spirit"

COLLOCATIONS:
・{全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}を{込|こ}めて (pouring in one's whole being)
・{全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}で{取|と}り{組|く}む (tackle wholeheartedly)
・{全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}をかける (stake one's all)
・{全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい}を{捧|ささ}げる (dedicate oneself completely)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい} - with all one's might
・{全力|ぜんりょく}で - with full effort
・{心血|しんけつ}を{注|そそ}ぐ - pour one's heart into
